title: WSDOT - Historic Traffic Sections 2019
description: 2019 estimated Annual Average Daily Traffic volumes along the state highway system. Data represents all directions of travel for the given roadway segment.
snippet: To fulfill federal reporting requirements and help meet departmental point-specific traffic information needs.
